title: Storage
intro: vinyl-check keeps its database in the application folder, and the recordings and masters in the user-data folder, which can be on another drive.
app_hint: Database with all measurements, judgments and settings, keys and caches. It belongs to the installation and stays where it is.
not_mounted: not mounted: the station does not record
missing: The folder cannot be reached (drive not mounted?). Measurements and grades stay visible; recording and listening do not work until it is back.
target_help: vinyl-check offers a folder on every drive it finds, earlier folders and one on the system drive. Choosing one checks it at once.
check_ok: {files} files, {gb} GB will be copied; {free} GB are free there.

check_already.one: {n} file is there already and is checked, not copied again.
check_already.other: {n} files are there already and are checked, not copied again.

delete_originals: Delete the originals after the move
delete_help: Only after every copy has been checked and the station has switched to the new folder.
confirm: Move {files} files ({gb} GB) to {path}? Recording is paused until the move is done.
relink_help: For data that is there already: a drive mounted under another name, or a copy made by hand. Nothing is copied; every file must be there.
relink_confirm: Point the station at {path}? Nothing is copied.
done: Moved: {files} files, {gb} GB. The station now uses {path}.

kept.one: {n} original could not be deleted and is still in {path}.
kept.other: {n} originals could not be deleted and are still in {path}.

cleanup_incomplete: The station restarted while deleting the originals: some may still be in {path}.
failed: The move failed: {error}. The station keeps using {path}; nothing was lost.
cancelled: Cancelled. The station keeps using {path}. Copies already made stay in the new folder; starting again continues there.
interrupted: The move was interrupted by a restart. The station keeps using {path}; start the move again to continue.
cancel_confirm: Cancel the move? The station keeps using the old folder.
paused_hint: Recording is paused while the folder moves.

outside_info.one: {n} file ({gb} GB) is still outside the user-data folder: {rec} recordings, {mas} masters. It is in:
outside_info.other: {n} files ({gb} GB) are still outside the user-data folder: {rec} recordings, {mas} masters. They are in:

outside_hint: Left behind when the folder was changed in the configuration file. Gathering copies them into the user-data folder, checks every copy against its original and then points the database at the copies.

outside_missing.one: {n} file the database refers to cannot be found (drive not mounted?); it stays as it is.
outside_missing.other: {n} files the database refers to cannot be found (drive not mounted?); they stay as they are.

gather_confirm: Copy {files} files ({gb} GB) into {path}? Recording is paused until it is done.
done_gather: Gathered: {files} files, {gb} GB are now in {path}.

check_outside.one: Including {n} file ({gb} GB) from outside the user-data folder.
check_outside.other: Including {n} files ({gb} GB) from outside the user-data folder.

custom_help: The full path of the folder; it is created if it does not exist yet. Then press Check.
